scope: K2: tw_price_1m partitioned gz-JSONL store, resumable newest-first two-year backfill, retention/quarantine pruner, disk guard, and permanent exclusion of tw_price_1m from the daily latest-snapshot projection. Source + tests only.

source_evidence.store: services/source_ingestion/intraday_store.py: normalized/tw_price_1m/<date>/<SYMBOL>.jsonl.gz sorted by bar_start; per-day manifest.json (row counts, per-symbol counts, content hashes); raw/tw_price_1m provenance envelope; idempotent on (symbol, session_date, bar_start), identical refetch rewrites nothing, differing OHLCV for an existing key quarantines the symbol-day and never overwrites; resolve_quarantine; manifest-driven pruner (2-year rolling accepted days, resolved quarantine expires after 90 days, unresolved quarantine never deleted, deletions logged to _logs/tw_price_1m_prune.jsonl, restricted to this dataset's directories); disk guard requires free >= max(10 x projected remaining bytes, 20 GB) on the INTRADAY_STORE_ROOT mount, raises disk_budget_exhausted and deletes nothing; measure_mount() runs df --output equivalent for hosted evidence.
source_evidence.backfill: services/source_ingestion/intraday_backfill.py: run_backfill uses K1 fetch_kbar + shared KBarHourlyBudget (default 4500/h), newest session first over the governed is_trading_day calendar, resumes by skipping manifest-complete symbol-days, stops with budget_exhausted/quota_402 (no same-hour retry) or credential_error (no retry, no substitute data), disk guard before start and each session date, default universe cap 200, 730-day window. Uses K1 normalize_kbar_payload so the complete 271-bar session and governed closures are kept; conflicting duplicates and unsupported session shapes are quarantined, the complete raw response is persisted; no truncation, imputation, padding or volume-tolerance change. coverage_report gives actual per-symbol coverage and missing days.
source_evidence.job_class: services/source_ingestion/active_universe.py: DEFAULT_SOURCE_UPDATE_RULES gains tw-finmind-kbar-1m / tw_price_1m (CORE+CANDIDATE, max 200 symbols per run, job_class intraday_minute_store_backfill, daily_snapshot_projection=excluded).
source_evidence.snapshot_isolation: services/source_ingestion/pipeline.py: persist_latest_market_snapshots drops every tw_price_1m record (connector id, dataset/normalized_target/source_dataset metadata) and skips the whole batch when the connector declares tw_price_1m. Reconciled-only minute projection stays K4's separate writer.
